title: VTC Networks — Join — payload
description: Accept a network's listing of the community: register groups for the network's roles, then acknowledge its membership offer. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

url.description: The network's API base, as the network's administrators gave it.

network.description: The network's DID. For a request naming a `url`, the community refuses if the network found there answers as another DID.

groups.description: The community's groups to serve the network's roles. Every role the network requires must be assigned.

Response.title: VTC Networks — Join — response payload
Response.description: The membership as it now stands.
